title: VisiData Lightning Demo at PyCascades 2018
summary: A five-minute lightning demo of VisiData, a terminal tool for exploring and manipulating data. It uses two months of NYC 311 complaint data to drill down, plot points on a virtual map and save selected rows.
why: HN recommends it as the fastest way to understand what VisiData can do, since seeing it work is clearer than reading about it.

quote.text: visdata is pretty mind-blowing...at least, that's how i felt when i saw the demo the first time
